entities.summary: Camilo García de Polavieja y del Castillo-Negrete, 1st Marquess of Polavieja was a Spanish general, born in a family of merchants. He was a competent commander, but considered as brutal as Valeriano Weyler of Cuba. He was one of the most relevant military officers of the time and a famous regeneracionista.
